searchText: Correct me if I'm wrong, but isn't this the same logic as for 1559? There is the maxFeePerGas (checked upon txPool) and then at some point the actual fee is deducted (which thus could be *much less* than the max fee) (in this case thus the data fee) (so maxFeePerGas -> maxFeePerDataGas in this case) <@892053833121923094> are there any checkpoint sync checks in hive? 4844 coming closer, its going to be more and more urgent to ensure every client can sync off of every other client. I've updated the docker compose scripts for devent-6, and able to sync lighthouse/geth if you're still interested: https://github.com/jimmygchen/eip4844-devnet thanks to @ ethpandaops - the instructions are pretty good! Cool! Hey! Blobscan is working again and syncing devnet6 - https://blobscan.com/ looks like the block explorer (blockscout) isn't able import blocks with blobs 🙈 Yea there isn't a blob supported blockscout version yet Not really, I think this can be improved, what did you have in mind? I'm thinking of starting a client, then build the chain with one of them, start a second one and then instructing this one to do a checkpoint sync to the first one and verify, ideally chain having full blobs. (And do this in a simulator that runs for all CL pairs)

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Correct me if I'm wrong, but isn't this the same logic as for 1559? There is the maxFeePerGas (checked upon txPool) and then at some point the actual fee is deducted (which thus could be *much less* than the max fee) (in this case thus the data fee) (so maxFeePerGas -> maxFeePerDataGas in this case)
